verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents interest-bearing accounts, sweep programs, rate mechanics, or who keeps the spread. The 1099-INT filing guide is tax reporting, and the checking-to-savings book transfer is only an example of moving money. Both are adjacent features that hint at interest but do not show the product delivering this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, idle balances can earn — interest-bearing accounts or documented sweep options, with the rate mechanics and who keeps the spread spelled out
